description: This file contains OS abstraction functions for thread management, process control, MAC address conversion, and command execution, specific to Linux systems, used within the Plume Design Inc. project.

methods.name: task_name_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current task name using prctl.

methods.name: task_name_set
methods.description: Sets the current task name using prctl.

methods.name: task_create
methods.description: Creates a new thread executing a specified function with given arguments.

methods.name: task_once
methods.description: Ensures a block of code runs only once in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: hwaddr_aton
methods.description: Converts a MAC address string to a byte array.

methods.name: os_popen
methods.description: Executes a shell command and returns the process ID and pipe descriptor.

methods.name: os_pid_from_file
methods.description: Reads a PID from a file and verifies if the process exists.

methods.name: os_pid_wait
methods.description: Waits for a process to terminate within a timeout.

methods.name: os_pid_terminate
methods.description: Attempts to gracefully terminate a process, then kills if necessary.

methods.name: os_pid_exists
methods.description: Checks if a process with given PID exists.

methods.name: cmd_log
methods.description: Executes a shell command, logs output, and returns exit status.

methods.name: os_get_opt
methods.description: Parses command-line options for verbosity and help.
